notes:
• New Bangla font: Bangla text in the app now uses BCC Purno, the same font as the website. English text keeps your phone's font.

• A category or the monthly total spent exactly to its limit now shows a green bar and a green tick. Only spending past the limit shows red.

• Developed by Abdullah Al Fahim in Settings, About now opens the developer's website.

Already on an older version? Open Settings, then App updates, to install this one. Your data stays. A backup made on 0.3.6 or later cannot be restored on an older version.
